isitan-pn.name: PN 17/90 · PN 20/76 — motorized pipe notching machines
isitan-pn.summary: Belt-sander tube notchers that cope a saddle on the end of a tube in seconds for welded handrail, roll-cage, furniture and frame joints. Ten dovetail drums from Ø3/4″ to 3″ are standard — pick the drum for the tube you are joining, clamp the workpiece in the moving clamp and notch square or at any angle up to 50°. The PN 17/90 takes tube from 11/16″ to 3-1/2″ OD on a 4 × 47″ belt; the PN 20/76 is the compact notcher with a movable clamp, 13/16″ to 3″ OD on a 4 × 79″ belt.
features: 10 dovetail drums standard: Ø3/4″, 13/16″, 1″, 1-1/4″, 1-1/2″, 1-5/8″, 1-7/8″, 2″, 2-3/8″, 3″ — quickly opens the right dovetail for each tube diameter
Fast clamping and release with the moving clamp; clamp moves left and right
Notching at any angle up to 50° with the movable clamp
PN 17/90: basic centering and easy belt adjustment, 4 × 47″ belt
PN 20/76: compact notcher with movable clamp, 4 × 79″ belt
3 HP motor; CE certified
optional: Special dovetail drums for other tube sizes
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

isitan-td-01.name: TD-01 — motorized tube-end deburring machine
isitan-td-01.summary: A bench deburring machine with a Ø10″ × 4″ wire brush at 1,500 rpm that cleans the inside and outside of a tube end in one pass, up to Ø3-1/2″ — round, rectangular, oval and other profiles in stainless, mild steel or aluminum. Sits beside the cold saw or the bender and takes the burr off before welding or bending, at very low running cost.

Wire brush Ø10″ × 4″ at 1,500 rpm — fast, easy deburring at high speed
Round, rectangular, oval and other profiles; stainless steel, mild steel, aluminum and more
Balanced, long-life construction; works alongside tube benders and saws
3 HP motor; low running cost, high productivity

isitan-sff.name: SFF 90-1 · SFF 60-1 — single-station hydraulic pipe-end forming machines
isitan-sff.summary: Hydraulic end formers that expand or reduce (collapse) a tube end with one tooling set, for exhaust slip joints, handrail sleeves, telescoping tube and furniture connectors. The SFF 90-1 expands Ø1-3/8″ to 3-1/2″ and reduces down from Ø5/16″ in 14 ga mild steel with a 15 HP power unit; the SFF 60-1 covers tube to Ø2-3/8″ with 10 HP. An easy tool-changing system swaps the forming set in minutes.
features: Expands or reduces (collapses) pipe ends in a single station
1 set of end-forming tooling in requested size; easy tool-changing system
Hydraulic power unit — 15 HP on the SFF 90-1, 10 HP on the SFF 60-1
Mobile foot pedal; CE certified
optional: Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

isitan-sfc-350-vx.name: SFC 350-VX — semi-automatic circular cold saw
isitan-sfc-350-vx.summary: A semi-automatic cold saw for short batch runs: foot-switch actuation, hydro-pneumatic head descent with a cutting-speed regulator and head stroke set to the material, so the operator loads and the saw cuts. Heavy-duty double gearbox, cast-iron base, two blade speeds and mitre cuts 45° each way — Ø4-1/2″ round and 3-7/8″ square mild steel on a 13-3/4″ HSS blade, burr-free and ready to weld.
features: Semi-automatic cycle: foot-switch actuation, hydro-pneumatic head descent with cutting-speed regulator; head stroke adjustable to material size
Heavy-duty double gearbox; cast-iron base; two blade speeds 45 / 80 rpm
Mitre cuts 45° right to 45° left; self-centering double split vise grips both sides of the material
Wet-type cold sawing for clean, burr-free cuts; coolant pump and tank
24 V control voltage; CSA-approved panel; air supply 85 psi (8.5 cfm)
optional: Saw blades for specific materials — TiN for medium-hard steel, TiCN for high-strength steel, TiAlN for stainless
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

specs.note: Cutting capacities are for mild steel at 90° and 45°. Wet-type cold sawing with the standard coolant pump; TiN, TiCN and TiAlN-coated HSS blades are available for medium-hard, high-strength and stainless steel. Air supply for the SFC 350-VX: 85 psi, 8.5 cfm.

isitan-sfc-350-vx.headline: 13-3/4″ blade · Ø4-1/2″ round · semi-automatic, 45 / 80 rpm

isitan-sfc-v.name: SFC 275 / 315-VP · SFC 275 / 315-V — circular cold saws with pneumatic or manual vise
isitan-sfc-v.summary: Pull-down circular cold saws with a 10-3/4″ or 12-1/2″ blade, two speeds and mitre cuts 45° left and right: the VP models clamp with an air-operated vise, the V models with a manual vise. Low-voltage start/stop trigger in the handle, a robust double-hinged pivot, a double split vise that grips both sides of the cut and a large base for stability — the metal cutting saw for tube, bar and profile in the fabrication shop, with a clean, burr-free cut the band saw cannot match.
